# DiogenesLamp

> A Rust command-line tool (`lamp`) that indexes public Yupoo seller catalogues into a
> local store and serves them as one searchable, infinite-scroll page. It fetches covers
> and metadata from public pages only; detail photos stay on Yupoo, linked from the viewer.

Version 0.1.0 (the Rust port) is unreleased and has no tagged release. Install from a
clone with `cargo install --locked --path .`; the toolchain is pinned in `rust-toolchain.toml`.

## Start

- [README](https://github.com/yungSNAT/DiogenesLamp#readme): install, use, data layout, diagnostics, politeness limits and development checks.
- [sources.example.toml](https://github.com/yungSNAT/DiogenesLamp/blob/main/sources.example.toml): an example of the seller source file that `lamp import` writes.
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/yungSNAT/DiogenesLamp/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): the Rust port and its documented divergences from the Python version.
